_comment: Parameters for the staging stack (sepsis-staging). Use a separate AWS account per environment. Budget and alert emails come from BUDGET_EMAIL / ALERT_EMAIL. Runs on ECS (no SageMaker quota needed): TrainingBackend=ecs, MlflowBackend=ecs, EnableSageMaker=false. EcsUseSpot=true runs the long tune and train steps on Fargate Spot (the short prepare and evaluate steps and the MLflow and Evidently services stay on demand); set it to false for on-demand capacity only. EnableSageMaker=true with TrainingBackend and MlflowBackend=sagemaker brings the SageMaker architecture back once the quota is approved.
